intro: Saint Lucia is a mountainous volcanic island with rainforest and dramatic peaks.

chapters.title: The Pitons
text: Gros Piton and Petit Piton, two steep volcanic spires rising from the sea, are a World Heritage site. Sulphur Springs near Soufrière is a 'drive-in volcano' with bubbling mud pools.

chapters.title: Rainforest
text: Rainforest covers the mountains and shelters the Saint Lucia parrot, the national bird.

places.title: Landscape tour
places.intro: Places that show the variety of Saint Lucia's landscapes. The numbers match the pins on the map.
